_about: Published figures the synthetic generator is calibrated to and validated against. status: verified = number checked against the paper or its abstract; provisional = number seen only in a secondary source, verify before relying on it; assumption = no published figure found, value chosen by the PoC team. Only verified and provisional targets are checked by validate.py; assumptions are reported but not scored.

targets.what: Share of Crohn's disease among CD+UC, Oslo (inception cohort)
targets.source: IBSEN III baseline: 626 CD, 1,082 UC (Scand J Gastroenterol 2021;56:899-905, PMID 34154494)
targets.note: 626 / (626 + 1,082). IBD-unclassified (71) excluded because the generator has no IBD-U.

targets.what: Share of women among UC patients, Oslo
targets.source: IBSEN III UC subset, ECCO congress abstract P353 (889 adult UC patients)
targets.note: Figure taken from a search-engine extract of the abstract; the abstract page returned 404 when checked. Verify.

targets.what: Share of current smokers among UC patients, Oslo
targets.source: IBSEN III UC subset, ECCO congress abstract P353

targets.what: UC, vedolizumab, no prior anti-TNF: clinical remission at week 52
targets.source: VARSITY: vedolizumab vs adalimumab in UC, 769 patients (Sands et al., N Engl J Med 2019;381:1215-1226)
targets.note: Trial population, moderate-to-severe UC; up to 25% could have had a non-adalimumab anti-TNF. Applied to the generator's anti-TNF-naive UC patients.

targets.what: UC, adalimumab, no prior anti-TNF: clinical remission at week 52
targets.source: VARSITY (Sands et al., N Engl J Med 2019)

targets.what: UC, infliximab, no prior anti-TNF: clinical remission at week 54
targets.source: ACT 1, infliximab 5 mg/kg (Rutgeerts et al., N Engl J Med 2005), as tabulated in a 2015 review
targets.note: Week 54, not 52. The NEJM abstract reports response, not remission; the remission figure comes from a review table. Verify against the paper.

targets.what: Crohn's, ustekinumab, no prior anti-TNF: clinical remission at week 52
targets.source: SEAVUE: ustekinumab vs adalimumab in biologic-naive Crohn's disease, 386 patients (Sands et al., Lancet 2022;399:2200-2211)
targets.note: 124/191. Trial population; the authors called the rates for both drugs unusually high.

targets.what: Crohn's, adalimumab, no prior anti-TNF: clinical remission at week 52
UC, ustekinumab, prior anti-TNF: clinical remission
targets.source: SWIBREG real-world ustekinumab in UC, 133 patients, mostly biologic-experienced (United European Gastroenterol J 2022, PMC9486503)
targets.note: Clinical remission at last follow-up (median 32 weeks), not week 52. Swedish registry data, the closest match to the PoC setting.

targets.what: Crohn's, infliximab, no prior anti-TNF: clinical remission at week 52
targets.source: No week-52 head-to-head figure found; set equal to adalimumab in SEAVUE
targets.note: Assumption: the two anti-TNFs perform alike in biologic-naive Crohn's.

targets.what: Crohn's, vedolizumab, no prior anti-TNF: clinical remission at week 52
targets.source: No comparable intention-to-treat week-52 figure found
targets.note: Assumption: lower than anti-TNF and ustekinumab in Crohn's, consistent with the direction in the literature.

targets.what: Share of Crohn's disease among biologic-treated patients, Swedish sites
targets.source: No published split for biologic-treated SWIBREG patients found
targets.note: Assumption. Ask SWIBREG for the real figure.
